title.zh: 站长推荐 · 自用资源

subtitle.zh: 下面是本站自己在用的云服务和工具，链接含邀请码。用不用都行，页面里写清楚了各自的限制和风险。
subtitle.en: Cloud services and tools this site actually uses. These links contain a referral code. No pressure — the limits and risks are spelled out below.

disclosure.zh: 以上均为推广 / 邀请链接。通过链接注册或购买，站长可能从平台获得返佣，不会额外增加你的费用；邀请链接本身不会提高注册者收益。价格、优惠、可用性与收益均以各平台官方页面和条款为准，请自行判断后再决定。
disclosure.en: All links above are affiliate / referral links. If you sign up or make a purchase through them, the site owner may receive a commission from the platform at no extra cost to you. A referral link does not increase your own earnings. Prices, discounts, availability and payouts are governed by each platform's official pages and terms — please make your own judgement.

desc.zh: 把闲置上行带宽分享出去换收益。我们在服务器上用 Docker 真跑过一遍：官方镜像约 4.2 MB，容器内存约 1 MB，跑完删容器磁盘零残留。
desc.en: Share unused upload bandwidth for a small income. We ran the official Docker image on a real server: about 4.2 MB image, ~1 MB container memory, zero disk residue after removal.

warning.zh: 重要限制：官方条款只允许住宅 IP，明确禁止服务器、VPN 和代理；用 VPS 挂机可能封号或拒付。邀请链接只是归因 ID，不给注册者额外奖励，$5 注册奖励已于 2024-03-01 取消。最低提现 $10。
warning.en: Important: the Terms allow residential IP addresses only and explicitly ban servers, VPNs and proxies — running it on a VPS risks account closure or withheld payouts. The referral ID gives you no signup bonus; the $5 bonus was removed on 2024-03-01. Minimum payout is $10.

desc.zh: 国内可直接调用的大模型推理平台，把各家开源模型聚合成统一 API。做自动化脚本、内容处理、AI 小工具时用来省掉自己搭推理环境。
desc.en: A model-inference platform that exposes popular open-weight LLMs behind one API. Handy for automation scripts, content processing and small AI tools without hosting your own runtime.

desc.zh: 自建服务、Docker 项目、镜像加速和对象存储都能用。活动页常有轻量应用服务器的入门机型，适合拿来练手部署。
desc.en: Useful for self-hosted services, Docker projects, registry mirrors and object storage. The deals page usually lists entry-level instances that are cheap enough for a first deployment.

desc.zh: 轻量应用服务器开箱即用，国内访问和备案配套比较顺手；也常用作自建工具的备用节点。具体配置和价格以活动页为准。
desc.en: Lighthouse instances are ready to use out of the box and pair well with domestic hosting requirements; also a common choice for a secondary self-hosted node. Check the campaign page for current specs and pricing.
